_about: Windows Terminal settings the loader applies at every start (essentials step, setting autoInstallEssentials). Merged into the PC's own settings.json after a backup: globals, profileDefaults (= profiles.defaults), the profiles here (matched by guid), defaultProfile and the key bindings (matched by id or keys) are set; everything else there is kept (other profiles, schemes, actions). Every tab (and every kit profile) starts in the kit's dev folder (prefer dev-folder: an existing D:\dev\github, C:\dev\github, D:\dev\git or C:\dev\git, else a new D:\dev\github or C:\dev\github). The font is set once CaskaydiaCove Nerd Font is installed. Field reference: docs/architecture.md#windows-terminal-settings

profiles.name: my-win-kit
profiles.commandline: cmd.exe /d /c if exist "%LOCALAPPDATA%\my-win-kit\launch.ps1" (powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "%LOCALAPPDATA%\my-win-kit\launch.ps1") else (echo my-win-kit: start the kit once with its installer, then this profile works & pause)
